summary: Billy Beasley was a multi-term state representative who ran for the Alabama Senate District 28 seat in the 2010 election. He defeated former Tuskegee mayor Johnny Ford in a Democratic runoff before facing Republican Kim West, and he moved from the House to an open Senate district that year.
political_profile: moderately conservative within the Democratic caucus (Shor–McCarty score -0.217)
important_caveats: The Shor-McCarty data is from his pre-election House service.
